volume_proxy: V=log(amount/median(previous21 amount)); NOT turnover or causal flow
y_main: log(O[s+2]/O[s+1]), exact common trading dates, same source block
freeze: At original I start tau, only labels with maturity<tau; latest504 source rows strictly before tau. Main s+2<tau, control s+1<tau. Coefficients carried until next I start including non-I days; no historical e rewritten.
fit: Training-only predictor centering/scaling. min sum((y-a-b*r-c*r*V)^2)+20*sum(standardized_predictor_coeff^2). Intercept unpenalized. AR-only same protocol is mechanism ablation.
kernel: e_j=tanh((b_frozen+c_frozen*V_j)*r_j/s_j); nuisance intercept not used; E=sum original21 normalized .9^k e; score=50+50*tanh(2E). Each historical j uses its own then-frozen theta.
unknown: Keep original queue slot, no new entry gate. Require all21 contributions and original PVR known; source invalid resets.
K: min(20,N) same exact original legal empty MOBILE PVR account day, same candidate/permission/pending/holding state. Original_PVR baseline rank and unknown slots preserved.
